Iron, nickel, and steel are ferromagnetic and attracted by magnets. Copper, silver, and gold are non-magnetic.
In equal time, X covers $50\text{ m}$ while Y covers $60\text{ m} \implies$ Speed ratio $= 5 : 6$.
Polished shiny surfaces are poor emitters and good reflectors of radiant heat; dull black surfaces emit and absorb heat rapidly.
Curved upper wing surface forces air to move faster, creating low pressure on top and high pressure below, producing aerodynamic lift.
Adding bulb 4 in parallel lowers circuit equivalent resistance, increasing total current and brightness of bulb 3.
During constant-temperature phase change (process 2), solid melts to liquid. Point 4 represents coexistence of liquid and boiling vapour.
Soft iron pieces placed near a magnet undergo magnetic induction; opposite poles develop at adjacent ends and attract.
Turmeric turns red in basic solutions (limewater Y). China rose turns magenta in acids (lemon juice Z) and green in bases. Salt solution X is neutral.
Glycerine is miscible and edible; table salt is soluble; copper coin is lustrous; matchstick floats on water.
Decaying fallen leaves is chemical (bacterial decomposition). Alloying is metallurgical. Paper shredding and crystallization are physical.
Camphor, naphthalene, and iodine sublime directly from solid to vapour upon heating; table salt and sugar do not.
Rusting requires both oxygen and moisture. The waterline region R of a ship exposed to splashing aerated seawater rusts fastest.
Blue vitriol $\text{CuSO}_4 \cdot 5\text{H}_2\text{O}$ turns white anhydrous $\text{CuSO}_4$ upon heating, releasing water vapour Z.
Methyl orange turns pink/red in acids (tamarind pulp, dilute acid mixture) and yellow in bases (glass cleaner).

Salivary amylase breaks starch into maltose in buccal cavity. Bile from liver is stored in gallbladder. Large intestine absorbs water/salts.
Lohi is a quality wool-yielding sheep breed native to Rajasthan and Punjab.
(i) Villi in small intestine, (ii) Stomach digests proteins with HCl/pepsin, (iii) Small intestine is $\approx 6\text{ m}$ long, (iv) Large intestine absorbs water.
Polar bears possess two thick layers of dense hollow hair fur over a thick layer of subcutaneous fat (blubber) for extreme thermal insulation.
P and V are autotrophic green producers; W and S are carnivores; U and R are omnivores; T is a saprotrophic decomposer.
Aorta carries oxygenated blood from left ventricle to body. Vena cava returns deoxygenated blood to right atrium. Pulmonary artery carries blood to lungs.
During inhalation, diaphragm contracts and flattens, external intercostals pull ribs upward and outward, thoracic volume expands, and air rushes in.
Wind-pollinated flowers are inconspicuous, small, light-coloured, lack fragrance/nectar, and produce enormous quantities of dry airborne pollen.
Human food is sourced from autotrophic plants and heterotrophic domesticated animals across diverse cultural culinary traditions.
Deficiency of Vitamin C causes scurvy (bleeding gums). Proteins are essential for muscle repair. Iron deficiency causes nutritional anaemia.
Proteinaceous animal fibres (silk, wool) curl away from flame, burn slowly with odor of burning hair, and self-extinguish; plant cellulose burns easily.
Radish and carrot are storage tap roots; grapevine has tendrils; *Opuntia* has flattened photosynthetic phylloclade stems.
Camels conserve water by excreting thick concentrated urine, producing dry dung, withstanding high body temperature swings without sweating.
Stages: Egg $\to$ Silkworm larva $\to$ Pupa enclosed in cocoon $\to$ Adult silkmoth.
Atmospheric air density and barometric pressure decrease exponentially with increasing altitude.
Human vertebral column contains 33 vertebrae (7 cervical, 12 thoracic, 5 lumbar, 5 sacral, 4 coccygeal). Rib cage has 12 pairs (24 total ribs).
Complete flowers (Petunia, Hibiscus, mustard) contain all 4 whorls. Incomplete/unisexual flowers (papaya, date palm) lack stamens or carpels.
Right-hand thumb rule determines circular magnetic field lines around conductor. Current upwards produces anticlockwise circular field lines.

Washing soda $\text{Na}_2\text{CO}_3$ (strong base $+$ weak acid) has $\text{pH} > 7$ (basic).
Mushroom is a saprotrophic fungus lacking chlorophyll; *Coleus* is a photosynthetic autotrophic angiosperm.
Bar screens trap coarse trash $\to$ grit chamber settles dense sand/gravel $\to$ primary clarifier sinks sludge $\to$ aeration tank decomposes dissolved organic matter with aerobic bacteria.
Curve section P-to-R represents exhalation (thoracic volume decreases, diaphragm relaxes and arches upward). R-to-T represents inhalation (diaphragm contracts and flattens down).
